name: astra
description: ASTRA - Astronaut Self-Triage & Readiness Assistant (NASA Space Apps 2026)

scripts.setup: cd engine && uv sync && cd ../web && pnpm install
scripts.dev:engine: cd engine && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.lint: cd web && pnpm lint && cd ../engine && uv run ruff check app tests
scripts.anatomy:build: uv run --no-project --with trimesh --with numpy --with scipy python -I -u scripts/build_anatomy.py
scripts.anatomy:optimize: cd web && pnpm exec gltf-transform optimize ../anatomy-raw.glb public/models/astra-anatomy.glb --compress meshopt --join false --flatten false --instance false --palette false --simplify false && node scripts/lod-anatomy.mjs public/models/astra-anatomy.glb public/models/astra-anatomy.glb
